## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND — mixed leadership and muted ratio signals confirm a neutral posture.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -1.72% | 1M: -6.77%) BELOW TREND (↓ falling) indicating lower realized volatility. Credit flat/neutral: HYG (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: +0.36% | 1M: -1.34%) RECOVERY — overall neutral credit signal. Commodities and crypto strength: IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral: SPY/TLT ratios muted and TLT (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY shows short-term demand for duration while the 1M trend remains weak, consistent with neutral financial conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech leading but narrow: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND while XBI (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -7.57%) RECOVERY and XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION show dispersion; sector breadth 2/11 argues style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.09% | 1M: -0.71%) BELOW TREND vs QQQ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +0.75%) ABOVE TREND. EM lagging: EEM (1W: -1.19% | 1M: +1.39%) CORRECTION and China FXI (1W: -0.49% | 1M: -3.81%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation elevated: ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND and ETHA (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +25.44%) ABOVE TREND with IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND — supportive for risk-taking given lower VXX.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Broad commodity bid but with short-term profit-taking: UGA (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +18.28%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND, while GLD (1W: +0.60% | 1M: -3.06%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +3.11% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY show mixed safe-haven demand.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy mixed/correcting: XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION while oil proxies USO (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +17.50%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION show 1W pullbacks against strong 1M gains; natural gas UNG (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +4.00%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND and IBIT/ARKK ABOVE TREND give pockets of leadership. Divergence alert: multiple commodity ETFs (USO, BNO, PDBC) show 1W weakness vs 1M strength — minor divergence signaling short-term profit-taking rather than regime change.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor selective exposure to leadership ETFs exhibiting clear up-trends (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad cyclical breadth given narrow market internals and SPY BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION, XME (1W: -4.36% | 1M: -7.17%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: UGA (1W: +4.66% | 1M: +18.28%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +2.13%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: USO (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +17.50%) CORRECTION, BNO (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +15.77%) CORRECTION — watch for continuation vs mean reversion.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (lower volatility complacency), HYG/LQD spread ~ watch for >0.80 shift in HYG/LQD (credit health), XLK/QQQ relative performance inflection vs SPY for market breadth, IBIT momentum break for speculative risk gauge.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, mixed ETF trends keep the market in a neutral posture. Tech/innovation (XLK (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +3.25%) ABOVE TREND; ARKK (1W: +5.56% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND) and crypto (IBIT (1W: +5.14% | 1M: +18.67%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow internals and commodity 1W/1M divergences that could widen if broader participation fails to follow.
